 Print November 2026 brings multiple festival holidays for school students, including Diwali, Govardhan Puja, Bhaiya Dooj, Chhath Puja and Guru Nanak Jayanti. November 2026 is set to bring several festival-related holidays for school students across India. With Diwali, Govardhan Puja, Bhaiya Dooj, Chhath Puja and Guru Nanak Jayanti falling during the month, students can expect multiple breaks from their regular academic schedules. However, the number of holidays will differ across states, depending on regional festivals and state-specific school calendars. For students and parents, keeping track of these dates is important for planning family visits, travel and other activities. While some states have announced extended Diwali vacations, others are expected to follow their respective academic calendars. Here is a look at the important November holidays and the state-wise school closure schedules. November 2026 school holidays : Complete festival-wise calendar
 November will feature several religious and regional observances, along with the regular Sunday holidays. The important dates that students should keep in mind are: Date Day Festival/Occasion 
 November 8 Sunday Diwali / Naraka Chaturdashi 
 November 9 Monday Govardhan Puja (in some states) 
 November 11 Wednesday Bhaiya Dooj / Chitragupta Jayanti (in some states) 
 November 15 Sunday Chhath Puja 
 November 16 Monday Veerangana Uda Devi Martyrdom Day (Uttar Pradesh) 
 November 24 Tuesday Guru Nanak Jayanti / Kartik Purnima / Guru Tegh Bahadur Martyrdom 
 The above dates provide an overview of the major occasions during November. However, not all festivals are observed as school holidays in every state. Students should refer to their respective school calendars for confirmation. Uttar Pradesh: Schools may remain closed from November 8 to 11
 Students in Uttar Pradesh may get an extended break around Diwali. Schools are expected to observe holidays from November 8 to November 11, covering Diwali, Govardhan Puja and Bhaiya Dooj. The state will also observe Veerangana Uda Devi Martyrdom Day on November 16. Students may get another holiday on November 24 on account of Guru Nanak Jayanti and Kartik Purnima, depending on the applicable holiday notification. Parents should check with their respective schools for the final vacation schedule. Maharashtra: Schools to remain closed from November 2 to 14
 Students in Maharashtra are scheduled to get an extended Diwali vacation in November. Schools across the state are expected to remain closed from November 2 to November 14, 2026, in view of Diwali and other festivals. This amounts to 13 consecutive days of holidays. With November 15 falling on a Sunday, students are expected to return to school on November 16. The extended break will give students an opportunity to celebrate the festive season and spend time with their families. Rajasthan: Diwali vacation may begin on November 4
 Schools in Rajasthan may observe an extended Diwali break from November 4 to November 15, 2026. However, the exact duration of the vacation may differ depending on individual school schedules. Students and parents are advised to confirm the dates with their respective school administrations before making travel or other holiday plans. Himachal Pradesh: Five-day holiday from November 6
 Students in Himachal Pradesh are expected to get a five-day break from November 6 to November 10, 2026. The holiday period will coincide with the Diwali festivities. Students should check their school calendars to know whether any additional holidays have been announced around the festival. What should students and parents keep in mind?
 Although November has several festivals and weekly holidays, the total number of school closure days will not be the same across the country. State education departments and individual school administrations determine the applicable holiday schedules. Parents should keep the following points in mind: Check the official holiday circular issued by the respective school.
 Confirm whether Diwali vacations have been extended beyond the festival dates.
 Check for any changes to examination schedules, practicals or other academic activities.
 Do not assume that every festival listed in the calendar will be observed as a school holiday.
 With multiple festivals falling in November, students in several states can expect breaks from regular classes. However, the final holiday schedule will depend on state-specific notifications and individual school calendars.
